verdict.rationale: Gitea's managed offering explicitly lets users "Choose your provider and region" [gitea-docs-32]. As a free self-hosted service with "full control" [gitea-docs-30], it can be deployed on any server or Kubernetes [gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-10, gitea-gh-4], so users decide exactly where their data lives. Community reports confirm running it on their own VPS and servers. Missing for 10: a documented list of available managed providers and regions, formal data-residency or compliance guarantees, and independent corroboration of region selection in the managed service.
